propositions: Project code-review criteria are excluded from eval/calibration surface because _code_review_prompt_id only admits built-in physical ids without repository context
calibrate_criterion maps non-physical ids through plan-review namespace and lacks code-review membership branch
_code_review_prompt_id must accept repo_root parameter and resolve active logical ids via code_review.registry.effective_criteria mapped to code-review gate
calibrate_criterion must select code-review arm when repo_root is provided and criterion_id exists in effective_criteria, resolving with criterion_prompt_id gate-qualified mapping
Project code-review criteria with missing eval specs must raise EvalError containing both logical criterion_id and eval-spec path
Backward compatibility requires plan-review criteria and built-in criteria to work unchanged with or without repo_root parameter
